summary: First testing run of CAT Habit Tracker (React + FastAPI + Mongo). Full backend suite (19 pytest cases) and full frontend Playwright flow passed. All requested features verified: email/password auth (admin + register), httpOnly session cookie, /auth/me + logout invalidation, settings GET/PUT with date validation, habits CRUD + toggle + stats (streak=1 after 1 toggle, completion_pct>0, heatmap=30, weekly=7), timetable CRUD, CSV/JSON upload with add & replace modes, invalid extension 400. Frontend login page renders with all data-testids, Apple Sign-In is disabled with 'Soon' badge, dashboard greeting shows 'Admin', 3 KPI cards (Completion ring / Streak 3D / Countdown 3D w/ EDIT GOAL), habits card, heatmap, weekly, schedule card all present. Habit checkbox toggle persists across reload and bumps streak to 1. EDIT GOAL modal updates exam to 'GMAT · COUNTDOWN' and day count refreshes. Manual schedule entry adds correctly. CSV upload (2 rows, mode=add) shows 'Imported 2 entries' toast and rows appear. LOGOUT clears session and visiting /dashboard while logged out redirects to /login.

issues: Day-letter computation in /api/habits/stats uses a contrived ternary that always falls into the same branch (the `if False else` near line 377 of server.py). Visually it still produces correct letters because the fallback expression is correct, but the dead `if False` branch should be cleaned up.

action_items: (Cosmetic only) Clean up dead `if False else` branch in habit_stats day-letter logic in /app/backend/server.py around line 377.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~620 lines and handles auth + settings + habits + timetable + parsing. Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/habits.py, routers/timetable.py, services/parser.py when adding more features.

CORS allow_origins defaults to '*' but allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject '*' when credentials are sent, so production deployments MUST set CORS_ORIGINS to explicit origins. Currently works because Emergent ingress handles preview origin, but flag this for prod.
Streak best calculation in habit_stats does max(best, streak) twice which is redundant but harmless.
Frontend AuthContext logs a 401 to console on first load when no session exists — expected, but could be silenced for cleaner UX.
Three.js StreakCard logs a deprecation warning 'THREE.Clock has been deprecated. Please use THREE.Timer instead.' — minor, upstream R3F.
All interactive elements (auth inputs, tabs, edit-goal modal, habit checkboxes, schedule add form, upload dropzone/inputs/buttons, logout) have data-testid - excellent testability.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@cattracker.app / Admin@2026 — works. Aspirant: aspirant@cattracker.app / Aspirant@2026 — seeded on startup, not directly exercised but verified via fresh registration flow.
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates ephemeral users with random emails for isolation. Created during FE test one fresh user (fe_<rand>@cattracker.app) and used admin for upload flow. Admin's exam_name was temporarily updated to GMAT inside test_update_settings then reset to CAT/2026-11-30. After FE EDIT GOAL test on admin, exam may remain at GMAT 2027-01-15 (last successful set was during the test); main agent can ignore as backend test resets but FE test doesn't.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. They use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and require live preview backend. For FE, file inputs use the dropzone pattern: the <input type=file data-testid=upload-file-input> is `hidden`, so Playwright must call `set_input_files` directly without wait_for_selector(visible). Habit-checkbox testids are dynamic `habit-checkbox-{habit_id}`; query selector_all('[data-testid^="habit-checkbox-"]') works. After FE test the admin user's exam may be set to 'GMAT' / '2027-01-15' — reset via PUT /api/me/settings if needed.
